title: Classic papers in programming languages
description: Landmark papers on computability, language design, semantics, type systems, concurrency, logic and database languages, and language implementation. Papers that introduce a formalism, concept or language are level 1 original-paper; surveys, analyses and essays are level 2. Links go to an open copy hosted by the author, institution or an archive where one legitimately exists, otherwise to the DOI.
